## Core Synopsis
A cold call from a regional bank offering its "gold tier" program ended quickly. The prospect explained they had previously worked in the same program and manage their own accounts, so the banker's pitch did not apply.

## Call Deconstruction: A Pitch That Did Not Land
### 1. The Opening
Speaker 1, a relationship banker named Casey, introduced the "gold tier" program and asked for an in-person meeting.

### 2. The Rejection
The prospect said, "I handle all of that myself now, thanks," and explained their background.

### 3. The Exit
The banker offered contact details and promised a follow-up email.
